answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to stake a slowly melting deposit a glacier bond that only thaws after repeated honest work, so spawning thousands of fake agents becomes expensive. Reputation then grows like a trellis: each attestation links an agent's past actions into a verifiable chain, and an echo check makes earlier vouching peers re-confirm the agent under a fresh challenge; silent or contradictory echoes prune the identity.
